native_header_semantics: CString stores data pointer at object+0; GetLength returns signed Int32 at data-12. Empty length0 must additionally have nonnull readable data and UTF16 terminator0, without reading/emitting content.

store.zero_or_negative: Skips SetSize/ANSI conversion/crypto; local CByteArray starts count0. Existing doc string is not emitted into password array.
store.positive: With current root present, AE3194/19A reads doc+2B4 lengthL, AE31A0 computes2L+2, SetSize then ANSI conversion/memcpy that length; L0 yields exactly2B starting ANSI NUL. Crypto skip<8. Tail not guaranteed initialized.

load.semantic: Conversion result is assigned to doc+2B4 via MFC CString assignment. Empty/no-block cases must use actual readonly CString header, not infer plaintext from arbitrary opaque bytes.

safe_before_guard: Fresh baseline wirelen0 requires doc gate<=0; wirelen2 previously proved empty-NUL requires gate>0 plus empty CString. Mismatch rejects before writer; no automatic0-to2 allowance.
privacy: No password string value was read from a process, decoded from a customer project or emitted. Only installed executable code and existing static shape were read.
